title: R-GEAN: Regimen-Guided Edit Action Network for Within-Admission Medication Change Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.22959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The medications prescribed to a patient often change during a hospital admission as clinicians start, stop, or continue therapies. We study whether models can predict which medication classes are added or removed between 24 hours after admission and discharge. Metrics that compare the complete discharge regimen can reward models for copying medications that remain unchanged, even when they identify no actual changes. We therefore introduce a leakage-controlled benchmark that predicts net ATC3 additions and removals using only prior completed admissions and information available within the first 24 hours of the current admission. Addition candidates are classes not active at 24 hours, whereas removal candidates are classes active at that time. translated_title: R-GEAN：用于住院期间用药变更预测的方案引导编辑动作网络
translated_abstract: 患者在住院期间，临床医生所开具的药物常常会发生变化，因为医生会开始、停止或继续某些治疗方案。我们研究模型是否能够预测从入院24小时后到出院之间，哪些药物类别被新增或移除。比较完整出院用药方案的评估指标可能会奖励那些仅仅复制未变化药物的模型，即使它们没有识别出任何实际的变更。因此，我们引入了一个防泄漏的基准测试，该基准仅使用既往已完成的住院记录以及当前住院前24小时内可获得的信息，来预测ATC3级别的药物净新增和净移除。其中，新增候选是24小时时未在使用的药物类别，而移除候选是当时正在使用的药物类别。我们还提出了R-GEAN，这是一种非对称的候选评分网络，具有相互独立的新增预测器和移除预测器。在来自82,286名患者的240,480次住院记录上，R-GEAN取得了最高的预测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个防泄漏的住院用药变更预测基准，并设计了具有独立新增与移除预测器的非对称候选评分网络R-GEAN，仅利用既往住院记录和入院前24小时信息即可准确预测住院期间用药方案的净变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a leakage-controlled benchmark for within-admission medication change prediction and proposes R-GEAN, an asymmetric candidate-scoring network with independent addition and removal predictors, which accurately predicts net medication changes using only prior admissions and information from the first 24 hours.
